verdict.rationale: NerdGraph GraphQL API is documented as letting you 'configure some New Relic features' (new-relic-docs-2, new-relic-docs-20), and NRQL-based alerts imply programmatic definition (new-relic-docs-21/25), while Terraform is documented for managing New Relic agent fleets (new-relic-docs-42) — but none of this pack explicitly documents a Terraform provider for dashboards/alerts, JSON dashboard export/import, or a dedicated dashboards-as-code workflow. missing for 10: explicit Terraform provider resources for dashboards/alerts, JSON dashboard model documentation, worked example of repeatable API-based provisioning.
